2.english_reference: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer

traditions.WLC: שְׁמַע אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣ י בְ שִׂיחִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: Εἰσάκουσον , ὁ θεός , τῆς προσευχῆς μου ἐν τῷ δέεσθαί με πρὸς σέ ,
traditions.VUL: Exáudi Deus oratiónem meam cum déprecor :
traditions.KJV: Hear my voice , O God , in my prayer :

2.english_reference: preserve my life from fear of the enemy

traditions.WLC: מִ פַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽ י

traditions.VUL: a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam .
traditions.KJV: preserve my life from fear of the enemy .

3.english_reference: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked

traditions.KJV: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked ;

3.english_reference: from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity

traditions.KJV: from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity :

4.english_reference: Who whet their tongue like a sword

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַ חֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: οἵτινες ἠκόνησαν ὡς ῥομφαίαν τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas ,
traditions.KJV: Who whet their tongue like a sword , [ and ]

4.english_reference: bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words

traditions.KJV: bend [ their bows to shoot ] their arrows , [ even ] bitter words :

5.english_reference: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect

traditions.KJV: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect :

5.english_reference: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not

traditions.WLC: פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗ הוּ וְ לֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ

traditions.KJV: suddenly do they shoot at him , and fear not .

6.english_reference: They encourage themselves [ in ] an evil matter :

traditions.VUL: Súbito sagittábunt eum , et non timébunt : firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam .
traditions.KJV: They encourage themselves [ in ] an evil matter :

6.english_reference: they commune of laying snares privily ;

traditions.KJV: they commune of laying snares privily ;

6.english_reference: they say , Who shall see them ?

traditions.KJV: they say , Who shall see them ?
They search out iniquities ;
they accomplish a diligent search :

7.english_reference: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep

traditions.WLC: וְ קֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְ לֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק
traditions.KJV: both the inward [ thought ] of every one [ of them ] , and the heart , [ is ] deep .

8.english_reference: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּרֵ֗ ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὁ θεός . βέλος νηπίων
traditions.KJV: But God shall shoot at them [ with ] an arrow ;
suddenly shall they be wounded .

9.english_reference: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכְשִׁיל֣וּ הוּ עָלֵ֣י מוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ ם

traditions.KJV: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves :

9.english_reference: all that see them shall flee away

traditions.VUL: Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos :
traditions.KJV: all that see them shall flee away .
And all men shall fear ,

10.english_reference: and shall declare the work of God

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: and shall declare the work of God ;

10.english_reference: for they shall wisely consider of his doing

traditions.KJV: for they shall wisely consider of his doing .

11.english_reference: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD

traditions.KJV: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD ,
and shall trust in him ;

11.english_reference: and all the upright in heart shall glory

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπαινεσθήσονται πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ .
traditions.KJV: and all the upright in heart shall glory .
